text:
maria: Heads up — after flipping the rollout for the new route precedence UI, a customer reported traffic going to us-west even when they set x-rw-region: eu-west-1. Can anyone triage?
henry: :eyes: saw one similar ticket. Do we have the full request headers / example?
maria: pasted the request they used:
```
GET /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
x-rw-region: eu-west-1
Authorization: Bearer ...
```
henry: quick thought: we recently moved header parsing earlier in the pipeline to support CDN-level overrides. If the CDN rewrites headers after our parse step, precedence could flip.
sophie: Is this why console rollout shows region-eval as `eu` but telemetry counts as `us`? UX is confusing for the customer.
aidan: can we add a quick integration test? curl with header + inspect response header `x-rw-routing-decision`. We emit that at the gateway level. Example: `curl -H "x-rw-region: eu-west-1" -I https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
infra-bot: probe-runner started simulation job job-8832 (10k requests, 50rps) targeting tenant:acme-corp with header override x-rw-region=eu-west-1
henry: Thanks infra-bot. If infra probe shows mixed results, check node affinity labels and route matcher order in the route table. New precedence was: client_hint -> cookie -> header -> geo_ip. Old was header -> geo_ip -> cookie.
maria: that's the diff. Console rollout PR changed precedence order (PR #4398) to prefer client_hint for edge compat. But the console UI still displays "region from header" as the primary signal — mismatch.
sophie: We need two things: 1) immediate rollback or emergency patch for dedicated tenants, 2) a console change so rollout UI reflects actual runtime precedence.
aidan: For a quick patch, we can add a tenant opt-in toggle: "honor-explicit-region-header" that forces header precedence for dedicated customers. Low-risk config flip.
henry: Agreed. I'll open a hotfix branch. Meanwhile can someone share a trace where header was eu-west but route label was us-west? We should inspect edge logs around header parse.
maria: attaching a short trace excerpt (sanitized):
```
incoming: x-rw-region=eu-west-1
edge-parse: client_hint=none, header=eu-west-1, geo_ip=us-west-2
route-decision: selected zone=us-west-2 (reason: precedence=geo_ip)
```
henry: there's the proof — runtime used geo_ip. That indicates precedence config didn't apply where this request hit. Could be an older routing config on a stale edge pool.
sophie: Console telemetry shows 97% of traffic honors header for this tenant, but the ticket is for a steady 3% mismatch. That suggests a subset of edge nodes.
aidan: I can add a small dashboard tile to surface mismatch rate by edge pool and by time. Quick panel: `sum(mismatch{tenant="acme-corp"}) by (edge_pool)`
henry: good. Also add metric for `routing_precedence_version` emitted as tag so we can see which nodes are on old config.
infra-bot: rollout-manager: hotfix branch created hotfix/region-header-precedent, CI started (build 7785).
maria: Thanks. For the customer-facing side, can we emit a response header `x-rw-routing-expl: header=eu-west-1; chosen=us-west-2; reason=preference=geo_ip` when mismatch occurs? That will help debugging.
aidan: we already have `x-rw-routing-decision` but not explanatory. I can extend it to include reason in the next patch.
sophie: action items: Henry opens hotfix PR and flips toggle for dedicated tenants; Aidan adds mismatch dashboard and expands `x-rw-routing-decision`; Maria to confirm with customer once hotfix is live.
henry: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/hotfix/4398-precedent. Requesting review from @maria and @aidan.
maria: reviewing now. If CI green, let's canary to pool-edge-eu and monitor mismatch tile for 10 minutes.
aidan: I'll start the probe job for canary and wire up alert: mismatch_rate > 0.5% for 5min -> pager.
sophie: Also schedule a small console UX tweak: the rollout modal should show "runtime precedence" not inferred precedence. Small copy change.
maria: perfect. thanks team. :thumbsup:
henry: will follow up in the hotfix PR comments with logs from the stale edge nodes.
infra-bot: probe-runner completed job job-8832: 10k requests, mismatch_rate=3.1% (edge_pool=pool-17)
aidan: pool-17 flagged. Starting canary patch to pool-17 first.
maria: ping me when canary is up.
henry: canary deployed to pool-17 (build 7785). Monitoring mismatch tile now.
infra-bot: alert muted for canary window (10m).
infra-bot: canary metrics: mismatch_rate dropped from 3.1% -> 0.04% in pool-17.
sophie: Nice. When hotfix is merged, let's coordinate a full rollout and add telemetry sampling to catch regressions.
maria: will confirm with customer and close the ticket after 24h steady state.
henry: postmortem note: tie routing_precedence_version to config deployments and surface in console release notes.
aidan: I'll prototype the UI snippet for "runtime precedence" and send a mock by EOD.
sophie: thanks all.
